name: Curiosity
tagline: I'm the size of a car and I've been climbing a Martian mountain since 2014.
discovery: I showed that Gale crater once held a freshwater lake, with the chemical ingredients needed for microbial life. I also found organic molecules there, the building blocks of the chemistry of life.
status_note: Still active: I keep exploring the layers of Mount Sharp, which tell how Mars dried out.

presentation.title: Hello, I'm Curiosity.
presentation.body: I'm a rover from the Mars Science Laboratory mission. I'm the size of a car and I've been climbing a Martian mountain since 2014.

chapters.title: A laboratory on wheels
chapters.body: I was designed to answer a big question: could Mars ever have supported life? I carry a real chemistry lab, a laser that vaporises rocks to analyse them, and a nuclear power source that does not depend on the Sun.

chapters.title: Eight months in space
chapters.body: On 26 November 2011, I leave Earth on an Atlas V rocket. For more than eight months, I cross space, safely tucked inside my capsule.

chapters.title: Seven minutes of terror
chapters.body: To land me, a rocket-powered "sky crane" lowers me on cables, then flies away. It is all automatic: signals take about 14 minutes to reach Earth, far too late to steer me.

chapters.title: An ancient lake
chapters.body: By drilling into a rock, I find clay: the trace of an ancient freshwater lake. Billions of years ago, microbes could have lived there.

chapters.title: Climbing Mount Sharp
chapters.body: Since 2014, I have been climbing Mount Sharp, a mountain more than 5 km high in the middle of the crater. Each layer of rock is like a page in the history of Mars.

chapters.title: Still at work
chapters.body: My wheels are worn by sharp rocks, but I keep driving. Every day, my discoveries help prepare future missions, perhaps with humans.

quiz.question: How did Curiosity land on Mars?
choices: Hanging under a rocket-powered sky crane
quiz.explanation: Too heavy for airbags, it was lowered on cables by a rocket-powered "sky crane".

quiz.question: What did Curiosity discover in Gale crater?
choices: Ice on top of Mount Sharp
quiz.explanation: The clays found by drilling show a freshwater lake existed there billions of years ago.
